name: XLA_JERS_ADR_LINES_
description: This table contains the assignments of the account rules to the journal line rule in a journal entry rule set.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Functional area within a software suite of products. For example, Financials or Payroll.

columns.name: AMB_CONTEXT_CODE
columns.description: Context of the accounting methods builder.

columns.name: JERS_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code of the type of the journal entry rule set. The possible values are: C: owned and defined by the user. S: owned and seeded by Oracle.

columns.name: JERS_CODE
columns.description: Code of the journal entry rule set.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Code of the event class.

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code of the event type.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_LINE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code of the type of the journal line type assigned to the journal entry rule set.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_LINE_CODE
columns.description: Code of the journal line type assigned to the journal entry rule set.

columns.name: FLEXFIELD_SEGMENT_CODE
columns.description: Segment code of the accounting flexfield.

columns.name: SEGMENT_RULE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code of the type of the account rule assigned to the journal line type assigned to the journal entry rule set.

columns.name: SEGMENT_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Code of the account rule assigned to the journal line type assigned to the journal entry rule set.

columns.name: SIDE_CODE
columns.description:
This column indicates which account is generated by the Account Rule The possible values are:
All: The rule generates both the gain and loss account.
Credit: The rule generates the gain account.
Debit: The rule generates the loss account.
NA : The line is not a gain/loss line; the rule generates the account used in the journal line.

columns.name: INHERIT_ADR_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicates if the value of the account rule is inherited from the journal entry line in a business flow configuration.

columns.name: SEGMENT_RULE_APPL_ID
columns.description: Application identifier of the account rule.

columns.name: ADR_VERSION_NUM
columns.description: Version number of the account rule.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
